# <span id="aanchor290"></span> Non-Physical Meters

FLOWCAL supports certain non-physical meter types that represent volumes derived from physical meters.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Calculated Meters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calculated Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Calculated Meters">

Calculated meters contain meter or location members that all contribute to the calculated meter total, based on direction and contribution factor. On the front end, calculated meters are treated the same as regular meters in that they will appear on reports when run by meter list. On the back end, calculated meters are handled like locations, maintaining the member relationships, and only displaying flow data from the Meter/Location Rollup Viewer. (See: [Calculated Meter Editor](../Calculated%20Meter%20Editor/Calculated%20Meter.md))

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Dead Oil Meters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Dead Oil Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Dead Oil Meters">

This meter type is part of the [Live Oil Management add-on](Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md). It can only be created as a child of a designated live oil meter. The calc method for dead oil meters is “Data Only”; data cannot be directly imported into a dead oil meter.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Flash Gas Meters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Flash Gas Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Flash Gas Meters">

This meter type is part of the [Live Oil Management add-on](Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md). It can only be created as a child of a designated live oil meter. The calc method for flash gas meters is “Gas Data Only”; data cannot be directly imported into a flash gas meter.

</div>

</div>
